name: Strong-Side E-X-T Combo Blitz
formation: 46 E-X-T Combo vs Pro I-Form Strong Right

summary.motive: Send three staggered strong-side rushers (end-B gap, tackle-C loop, linebacker-edge) so one protection slide always leaves the second-wave looper unblocked.
summary.keyDefender: DT running the loop — his path is invisible until he bursts out of the crashing end’s trash
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive linemen block the first rusher they see; the crash occupies guard and tight end while the loop and edge arrive together on an uncovered tackle.
summary.failureMode: A max-protect formation with a back releasing to the strong side adds the missing blocker and kills the loop’s timing.

beats.title: 1. The E-X-T Stack Call
beats.text: The end is called into a hard B-gap crash, the shaded tackle is told to loop all the way around him to the outside, and SAM rushes the edge widest. Three staggered waves hit one protection gap.

beats.title: 2. First Wave Occupies Two Blockers
beats.text: The crashing end slams inside off the tight end and engages the right guard, eating both the guard and the tight-end chip while opening the arc behind him.

beats.title: 3. The Loop Appears Out of Nowhere
beats.text: The tackle has sprinted a full circle behind the crash and appears inside the right tackle just as SAM forces that tackle to widen. Protection has nobody left for him.

beats.title: 4. Hit While Throwing
beats.text: The QB feels the free runner and hurries his throw to the corner route; the looping tackle arrives mid-throw and the pass sails incomplete with FS waiting over the top.

relations.tell: The shaded tackle swings wide behind the crashing end rather than firing straight — pure interior slants never leave the box.
